basic_details.job_title: MSEBHCL Company Secretary Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: MSEB Holding Company Ltd. (MSEBHCL) has invited applications under Advertisement No. 11/2026, dated 25 November 2026, for the post of Company Secretary on a contractual/deputation basis for 3 years. Applications must be sent by post to The Chief General Manager (HR), 4th Floor, Prakashgad Corporate Office, Bandra (E), Mumbai-51, so as to reach the office on or before 15 December 2026.

qualification.details: Essential: Graduate Degree from a recognized University with Membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India, with computer literacy. Preferable: Degree in Law from a recognized University / Institute. Candidates should have adequate knowledge of Marathi. | The pay scale is Rs.140655-5980-272215. Selected candidates are entitled to DA, HRA, Medical Benefit, CPF etc. as per the Rules of the Company. Statutory deductions are as per the rules. | The appointment is on a contractual/Deputation basis for a period of 3 years after joining the Company. The tenure may be extended further by one year, as per performance and as per the requirement of the Company. The contractual engagement may be terminated or discontinued by either side after one-month prior notice, without assigning any reason.

important_instructions: Incomplete applications, and those not supported by self-attested copies of certificates, are liable to be summarily rejected. Applications not in the prescribed format, or without copies of documents supporting educational qualification and experience, will not be considered. False or incorrect information leads to disqualification; if appointed, the person is liable to dismissal without notice or reasons. The form's declaration asks for the number of living children and the number born after 28/03/2005; the declaration text also refers to children born after 28/03/2006, and a candidate with more than two living children on that basis is liable to be disqualified. The form also asks whether any criminal charge sheet or FIR is pending against the applicant. Requests to change the date of the selection process or the address, or to add supporting documents later, will not be entertained. MSEBHCL reserves the right to seek service records and disciplinary action information from present or previous employers. The Company reserves the right to change (cancel / modify / add) any criteria or method of selection. Its decision in recruitment matters is final, and disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the Mumbai Court.

content_sections.heading: MSEBHCL Company Secretary at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies.

rows.details: Graduate Degree from a recognized University with Membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India, with computer literacy

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Post the application in the prescribed format, with supporting documents for age, qualification and experience, to the address below so that it reaches the office on or before 15/12/2026. The Company is not responsible for postal or courier delay, and applications received after the due date are not entertained. Candidates are advised to keep a photocopy of the application posted.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential: Graduate Degree from a recognized University with Membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India, with computer literacy. Preferable: Degree in Law from a recognized University / Institute. Candidates should have adequate knowledge of Marathi. The pay scale is Rs.140655-5980-272215. Selected candidates are entitled to DA, HRA, Medical Benefit, CPF etc. as per the Rules of the Company. Statutory deductions are as per the rules. The appointment is on a contractual/Deputation basis for a period of 3 years after joining the Company. The tenure may be extended further by one year, as per performance and as per the requirement of the Company. The contractual engagement may be terminated or discontinued by either side after one-month prior notice, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format, with a recent passport size photograph affixed and signed across. Demand draft of Rs. 600 favouring "MSEB Holding Company Ltd." (not required from Persons with Disabilities claiming reservation). Supporting documents for age, qualification and experience, as self-attested copies of certificates/testimonials. No Objection Certificate issued by the employer, for employees of a Govt. / Semi Govt. Undertaking, to be produced at the time of interview/verification of documents.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes preliminary scrutiny, shortlisting and a Personal Interview, followed by verification of original documents. Preliminary scrutiny of applications is carried out. Only candidates shortlisted with the benchmark to be decided by the Selection Committee are called for the selection process. Meeting the prerequisites does not entitle a candidate to be called, and candidates are shortlisted commensurate with the number of vacancies. Shortlisted candidates appear for the Personal Interview, conducted at Mumbai, at their own cost. Travelling expenses are not reimbursed. The recruitment is done strictly as per merit, giving appropriate weightage to each tool in the selection process. Candidates called for the selection process and those selected are intimated through email only. The Company verifies eligibility against original documents only after the candidate has qualified the final selection process and before the offer/appointment letter is issued. Admission to all stages is purely provisional, subject to meeting the eligibility criteria.

The form also asks whether any criminal charge sheet or FIR is pending against the applicant. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MSEBHCL Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office on or before 15/12/2026. Late applications are not entertained, and the Company is not responsible for postal or courier delay.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for MSEBHCL Company Secretary?
faq.answer: A Graduate Degree from a recognized University with Membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India, with computer literacy. A Degree in Law is preferable, and 5 years of post-qualification experience as Company Secretary in a listed Company is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for MSEBHCL Company Secretary?
faq.answer: Not more than 45 years as on the date of advertisement, 25/11/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the MSEBHCL Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: The pay scale is Rs.140655-5980-272215. DA, HRA, Medical Benefit and CPF are payable as per the Rules of the Company.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for MSEBHCL Company Secretary?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 600 including CGST and SGST, paid by demand draft favouring "MSEB Holding Company Ltd." Persons with Disabilities claiming reservation are exempted.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the MSEBHCL Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: Post the application in the prescribed format with supporting documents to The Chief General Manager (HR), 4th Floor, Prakashgad Corporate Office, Bandra (E), Mumbai-51. Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF COMPANY SECRETARY MSEBHCL" on top of the envelope.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for MSEBHCL Company Secretary?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised and candidates are shortlisted using a benchmark decided by the Selection Committee. Shortlisted candidates appear for a Personal Interview at Mumbai.

faq.question: Q8. Is the MSEBHCL Company Secretary job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is on a contractual/Deputation basis for 3 years after joining. The tenure may be extended by one year as per performance and the Company's requirement.

faq.question: Q9. Are travel expenses paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. Shortlisted candidates attend the Personal Interview in Mumbai at their own cost, and travelling expenses are not reimbursed.

faq.question: Q10. Is knowledge of Marathi required?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates should have adequate knowledge of Marathi.
